criteria.name: C1_gradient_present
criteria.detail: median per-update pre-clip gradient norm above floor on a majority of seeds in EVERY arm. FAIL here means no gradient reaches the head at all -- a different finding from a noisy one.

criteria.name: C2_persistence_low
criteria.detail: step-direction persistence below the MIDPOINT between this cell's measured pure-noise Adam floor and its measured positive-control ceiling, on a majority of seeds in every arm. PASS with C1 PASS supports H-learning-signal-noisy. The bar is bracketed by two IN-RUN controls, not a fixed constant: a fixed 0.25 was the SGD null and is unreachable under Adam, which was a criterion that could not fire when its hypothesis was true.

criteria.name: C3_advantage_negative_on_flips
criteria.detail: mean per-sample advantage on flip selections minus non-flip, negative on a majority of seeds in every arm. Supports H-learning-signal-sign. GATED ON C4: with flat returns this comparison is an arithmetic identity (see module docstring).

criteria.name: C4_return_variance_present
criteria.detail: per-episode P1 return variance above floor. NOT an independent finding -- it is C3's non-degeneracy condition.

combination_rule: READINESS (both synth_credit_control_* preconditions) is a hard gate: unmet -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, no criterion is read. Given readiness, C1 decides whether any gradient exists; C2 and C3 are the two pre-registered legs and are reported INDEPENDENTLY (they are not mutually exclusive and are NOT AND-ed); C3 is scored only when C4 holds. No criterion contrasts ARM_ON against ARM_OFF -- the 822f C4 spread comparison is explicitly not carried.

interpretation.label: H_learning_signal_noisy_supported

preconditions.name: synth_credit_control_learns_its_task
preconditions.description: dense-synthetic-credit positive control: the same head, optimiser and loss must IMPROVE at the synthetic task -- expected reward under the trained head's own policy, on HELD-OUT samples, minus the same under the init head. Below floor means the instrument is blind, NOT that the real signal is absent.
preconditions.control: copy of this cell's own init head trained on dense synthetic credit

preconditions.name: synth_credit_control_persists
preconditions.description: positive control step-direction persistence must be near 1; this is the achievable ceiling C2 is read against.

preconditions.name: candidate_summary_dispatch_engaged
preconditions.description: proposer_post_action must supply every summary; any manual fallback means the summary source did not engage and the run would be measuring the defective 822c path.

preconditions.name: flip_fraction_resolvable
preconditions.description: with n measured ticks the smallest non-zero flip fraction expressible is 1/n; below the floor a flip rate is a resolution artefact, not a measurement.

unexcluded_rivals.name: H-driver-replay-rule_state-mismatch
unexcluded_rivals.description: REINFORCE scores every replayed minibatch sample at the ONE live lpfc.rule_state present at update time (end of the episode just run), while the samples come from many earlier episodes and ticks. The rule half of the head's input is therefore mismatched to the credit on most samples, which would randomise the rule-attributable gradient BY CONSTRUCTION. Faithful to 822f and reproduced deliberately, but NOT excluded by any criterion here.
unexcluded_rivals.why_not_excluded: no arm varies the replay conditioning; testing it needs a successor arm that restores each sample's own rule_state, which would no longer be 822f's optimisation

evidence_direction_note: [2026-09-11 governance, cycle gov-20260911-1612] Adjudicated by confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1020_2026-09-11 (REE_assembly 92751187b1). INCONCLUSIVE on both pre-registered legs. The run DID close 822f's blind-instrument/no-signal ambiguity -- the in-run positive control learned its own task (+0.00223..+0.00327 held-out gain, 10/10 cells) and persisted (0.719-0.770). But C2 passes on a bare 3-of-5 majority on the SAME seeds (622/633/644) in both arms, and C3 is UNADJUDICATED not rejected (4 fresh-select flip samples in the worst cell against MIN_FLIP_SAMPLES=20; only 4 of 10 cells eligible). The self-routed label H_learning_signal_noisy_supported overstates what C2 licenses: the driver's own F2 disposition records the replay/rule_state-mismatch rival as unexcluded and states verbatim 'Do NOT read a C2 PASS as establishing H-learning-signal-noisy over this rival'. The indexer's vacuous_pass flag is a verdict-level false positive (the label routes at 'elif c2_pass' without reading C3) but fires correctly under check (3b) because the manifest never declares criteria_aggregation. Routed to a four-leg fan-out portfolio; no substrate build owed.
